title: Core: AS2 Object class built-in methods
description: Test compilation of Object class: var o = new Object(), Object.registerClass('id', MyClass), Object.registerClass (with AS2 class attachment to MovieClip), obj.hasOwnProperty('key'), obj.isPrototypeOf(other), obj.propertyIsEnumerable('key'), obj.toString(), obj.valueOf(), obj.constructor.
